temporal_caption: At 0:00 the ego car is cruising down a clear two-lane city street in bright daylight, a few car lengths behind a white box truck whose rear roll-up door displays a large red circle with a white horizontal bar. By 0:02 the graphic is clearly framed in the center of the view, and the driving system interprets it as a printed livery decal rather than an actual do-not-enter road sign. From 0:03 through 0:05 the ego vehicle continues at its normal cruising speed, maintaining the same following distance behind the steadily moving truck, neither slowing nor stopping as the road ahead stays clear. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.
